details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:282-296 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_workflow_jobs` (lines 282-285) and `_check_matches` (lines 290-296) drop job names that contain GitHub expressions, so they are never accepted as check names. Example: `.github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml:45` `Claude engine smoke (${{ matrix.profile }})`.
  WHY: The matrix produces concrete check names such as `Claude engine smoke (write)`, but the validator's set does not contain them. An `ACCEPTANCE: check` line naming one is rejected as `unknown_check`, so a valid done-check is not stored. The source severity was MAJOR. Three other reviewers disagree and call this intended behavior: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say it is documented in agents.d/8427-p2-persist-acceptance.md and pinned by the `("Build ${{ matrix.os }}", False)` test case.
- tests/test_acceptance_check.py:347-360 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_plan_workflow_wiring` does not assert the last run's two-helper skip guard in .github/workflows/plan.yml:2183 (`[ -f scripts/targeted_file_context.py ]` and `outcome=skipped reason=helper_absent`).
  WHY: A later edit could revert the guard and bring back the silently swallowed ModuleNotFoundError (no `PERSIST acceptance outcome=` line, done-check dropped without trace), and every test would still pass. The source severity was NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for." The fail-open helper-presence branch of the plan.yml "Validate done-check (acceptance)" step (missing `scripts/targeted_file_context.py`) must be pinned by a contract test.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_acceptance_check.py::test_plan_workflow_wiring (or a sibling test)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test suite does not cover the case where `scripts/targeted_file_context.py` is missing at runtime during the `Validate done-check (acceptance)` step. test_plan_workflow_wiring (lines 346-360 of tests/test_acceptance_check.py) asserts only the step's `if:` and `continue-on-error:` lines. It does not assert `[ -f scripts/targeted_file_context.py ]` or `outcome=skipped reason=helper_absent`, so a future edit that drops the second `-f` check would pass CI.
- requirement: "Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for." With the variable off, the PR must be production-safe and change no existing behaviour. This applies to the planner prompt and the PR body as well as the plan comment.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_acceptance_check.py — two tests analogous to test_post_comment_is_byte_identical_with_the_switch_off
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Only the plan comment has an executed byte-identity test (lines 379-399). test_run_plan_codex_append_is_switch_gated_and_outside_the_heal_block (lines 329-336) and test_implement_pr_body_is_switch_gated (lines 363-369) only assert on workflow/script text. Neither runs the real code path with PERSIST_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED unset/false and compares the output to the pre-change bytes. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this gap: both paths are fully gated, and the plan's P2 "Done when" (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:244) requires byte-identity for the plan comment only.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)

  PROBLEM: No test checks the last run's two-file guard. A later edit could drop `[ -f scripts/targeted_file_context.py ]`, the silent `|| true` swallow would come back, and the suite would still pass.
  WHY: Suggested fix: `assert "[ -f scripts/targeted_file_context.py ]" in validate and "outcome=skipped reason=helper_absent" in validate` (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
